quranTranslation.text: Who have believed and whose hearts have rest in the remembrance of Allah. Verily in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest!

explanation.bs: Srca se smiruju spominjanjem Allaha – srce vjere.
explanation.en: Hearts find rest in the remembrance of Allah — the heart of faith.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence.

explanation.bs: Pouka za onoga ko ima srce – sposobnost da shvati.
explanation.en: A reminder for whoever has a heart — the capacity to understand.

quranTranslation.text: And the heart of the mother of Moses became void, and she would have betrayed him if We had not fortified her heart, that she might be of the believers.

explanation.bs: Srce (فُؤَاد) Musaove majke ostalo je „prazno” (tefsir se razilazi: bez strpljenja, ili bez svega osim misli na sina), a u istom ajetu Allah učvršćuje njeno قَلْب: unutrašnji nemir je فُؤَاد, postojanost قَلْب.
explanation.en: The heart (fuʾād) of Moses' mother became “void” (tafsir differs: of patience, or of all but her son), and in the same ayah Allah fortifies her qalb: the inner upheaval is named fuʾād, the steadfastness qalb.

quranTranslation.text: The heart lied not (in seeing) what it saw.

explanation.bs: Srce nije poreklo ono što je vidjelo – unutrašnji doživljaj.
explanation.en: The heart did not deny what it saw — inner experience.

quranTranslation.text: Which leapeth up over the hearts (of men).

explanation.bs: Vatra koja se diže do srca – ar-Rāġib kaže da spominjanje srca ovdje ukazuje na to koliko ih vatra snažno pogađa.
explanation.en: The fire that mounts up to the hearts — ar-Rāġib says naming the hearts here points to how intensely the fire affects them.

quranTranslation.text: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate,

explanation.bs: „Zar ti nismo raširili grudi tvoje“ – širenje grudi.
explanation.en: “Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate” — the breast expanded.

quranTranslation.text: And whomsoever it is Allah's will to guide, He expandeth his bosom unto the Surrender, and whomsoever it is His Will to send astray, He maketh his bosom close and narrow as if he were engaged in sheer ascent. Thus Allah layeth ignominy upon those who believe not.

explanation.bs: Grudi se šire za islam ili postaju tijesne – širenje i stezanje.
explanation.en: The breast opens to Islam or becomes tight — expansion and constriction.

quranTranslation.text: Saying: My Lord! Lo! the bones of me wax feeble and my head is shining with grey hair, and I have never been unblest in prayer to Thee, my Lord.

explanation.bs: Zekerija: „Gospodaru moj, kosti su mi zaista oslabile“ – tjelesna slabost starosti.
explanation.en: Zechariah: “My Lord! Lo! the bones of me wax feeble” — the bodily weakness of age.

quranTranslation.text: And with how many a prophet have there been a number of devoted men who fought (beside him). They quailed not for aught that befell them in the way of Allah, nor did they weaken, nor were they brought low. Allah loveth the steadfast.

explanation.bs: „Nisu klonuli zbog nevolja koje su ih na Allahovom putu snašle, niti su oslabili (ضَعُفُوا)“ – obje riječi u jednom ajetu.
explanation.en: “They quailed not for aught that befell them in the way of Allah, nor did they weaken (ضَعُفُوا)” — both words in one ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Faint not nor grieve, for ye will overcome them if ye are (indeed) believers.

explanation.bs: „Ne klonite i ne tugujte – vi ste nadmoćniji“ – zabrana klonuća.
explanation.en: “Faint not nor grieve, for ye will overcome them” — losing heart forbidden.

quranTranslation.text: Allah would make the burden light for you, for man was created weak.

explanation.bs: „A čovjek je stvoren slabim“ – ar-Rāġib: slabost u mnoštvu potreba.
explanation.en: “For man was created weak” — ar-Rāġib: weakness in the many needs.

quranTranslation.text: Those who believe do battle for the cause of Allah; and those who disbelieve do battle for the cause of idols. So fight the minions of the devil. Lo! the devil's strategy is ever weak.

explanation.bs: „Šejtanovo spletkarenje uistinu je uvijek slabo“ – slabo prema onima koji vjeruju.
explanation.en: “Lo! the devil's strategy is ever weak” — weak against those who believe.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! When ye contract a debt for a fixed term, record it in writing. Let a scribe record it in writing between you in (terms of) equity. No scribe should refuse to write as Allah hath taught him, so let him write, and let him who incurreth the debt dictate, and let him observe his duty to Allah his Lord, and diminish naught thereof. But if he who oweth the debt is of low understanding, or weak, or unable himself to dictate, then let the guardian of his interests dictate in (terms of) equity. And call to witness, from among your men, two witnesses. And if two men be not (at hand) then a man and two women, of such as ye approve as witnesses, so that if the one erreth (through forgetfulness) the other will remember. And the witnesses must not refuse when they are summoned. Be not averse to writing down (the contract) whether it be small or great, with (record of) the term thereof. That is more equitable in the sight of Allah and more sure for testimony, and the best way of avoiding doubt between you; save only in the case when it is actual merchandise which ye transfer among yourselves from hand to hand. In that case it is no sin for you if ye write it not. And have witnesses when ye sell one to another, and let no harm be done to scribe or witness. If ye do (harm to them) lo! it is a sin in you. Observe your duty to Allah. Allah is teaching you. And Allah is knower of all things.

explanation.bs: „A ako je onaj koji duguje nerazborit ili slab…“ – ar-Rāġib (po el-Halilu): ovdje slabost uma i rasuđivanja, pa za njega diktira staratelj.
explanation.en: “But if he who oweth the debt is of low understanding, or weak…” — ar-Rāġib (after al-Khalīl): weakness here of mind and judgement, so his guardian dictates.

quranTranslation.text: And He giveth you of all ye ask of Him, and if ye would count the bounty of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! man is verily a wrong-doer, an ingrate.

explanation.bs: „Ako biste brojali (تَعُدُّوا) Allahove blagodati, ne biste ih mogli pobrojati (لَا تُحْصُوهَا)“ – brojanje je moguće, potpuno obuhvatanje nije.
explanation.en: “If ye would count (تَعُدُّوا) the bounty of Allah ye cannot reckon it (لَا تُحْصُوهَا)” — counting is possible, encompassing is not.

quranTranslation.text: That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things.

explanation.bs: „On obuhvata sve što je kod njih i svaku je stvar pobrojao (وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَدًا)“ – ar-Rāġib: dokučio je i obuhvatio.
explanation.en: “He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things (وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَدًا)” — ar-Rāġib: obtained and encompassed it.

quranTranslation.text: On the day when Allah will raise them all together and inform them of what they did. Allah hath kept account of it while they forgot it. And Allah is Witness over all things.

explanation.bs: „Allah je to pobrojao (أَحْصَاهُ اللَّهُ), a oni su to zaboravili.“
explanation.en: “Allah hath kept account of it (أَحْصَاهُ اللَّهُ) while they forgot it.”

quranTranslation.text: Verily He knoweth them and numbereth them with (right) numbering.

explanation.bs: „On ih je doista sve pobrojao (أَحْصَاهُمْ) i izbrojao ih tačnim brojem (وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا)“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet uz عَدّ, gdje obje riječi stoje jedna uz drugu.
explanation.en: “Verily He knoweth them (أَحْصَاهُمْ) and numbereth them with (right) numbering (وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا)” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah for عَدّ, where both words stand side by side.

quranTranslation.text: And they will bid thee hasten on the Doom, and Allah faileth not His promise, but lo! a Day with Allah is as a thousand years of what ye reckon.

explanation.bs: „Zaista je dan kod tvoga Gospodara kao hiljadu godina od onih koje vi brojite (مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ)“ – ljudsko brojanje.
explanation.en: “A Day with Allah is as a thousand years of what ye reckon (مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ)” — human counting.

quranTranslation.text: And they say: What aileth us that we behold not men whom we were wont to count among the wicked?

explanation.bs: „Šta nam je, pa ne vidimo ljude koje smo ubrajali među zle?“ – brojati kao ubrajati, smatrati.
explanation.en: “What aileth us that we behold not men whom we were wont to count among the wicked?” — counting as reckoning among.

quranTranslation.text: Who made all things good which He created, and He began the creation of man from clay;

explanation.bs: „… i započeo je stvaranje čovjeka od ilovače“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… and He began the creation of man from clay” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Then he (Joseph) began the search with their bags before his brother's bag, then he produced it from his brother's bag. Thus did We contrive for Joseph. He could not have taken his brother according to the king's law unless Allah willed. We raise by grades (of mercy) whom We will, and over every lord of knowledge there is one more knowing.

explanation.bs: „Pa je počeo od njihovih vreća, prije vreće svoga brata …“ – osnovni smisao: jedno staviti ispred drugoga.
explanation.en: “Then he (Joseph) began the search with their bags before his brother's bag” — the basic sense: putting one thing before another.

quranTranslation.text: Then fashioned We the drop a clot, then fashioned We the clot a little lump, then fashioned We the little lump bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, and then produced it as another creation. So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators!

explanation.bs: „… zatim smo ga podigli kao drugo stvorenje …“ – nakon stupnjeva, novi rast; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… and then produced it as another creation” — after the stages, a new growth; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.bs: podići u postojanje, dati da nastane i raste
gloss.en: to bring forth, to bring into being and raise

quranTranslation.text: He it is Who showeth you the lightning, a fear and a hope, and raiseth the heavy clouds.

explanation.bs: „… i podiže teške oblake“ – oblaci koji nastaju i rastu malo-pomalo; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… and raiseth the heavy clouds” — clouds that form and grow bit by bit; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.bs: podići u postojanje, dati da nastane i raste
gloss.en: to bring forth, to bring into being and raise

quranTranslation.text: Say (O Muhammad): Travel in the land and see how He originated creation, then Allah bringeth forth the later growth. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.

explanation.bs: „… zatim Allah podiže posljednje nastajanje …“ – drugo stvaranje, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “… then Allah bringeth forth the later growth” — the second coming-to-be, as befits Him.

gloss.bs: podići u postojanje, dati da nastane i raste
gloss.en: to bring forth, to bring into being and raise

quranTranslation.text: The Originator of the heavens and the earth! When He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.

explanation.bs: „Stvoritelj nebesa i Zemlje! Kad odredi neku stvar, samo joj kaže: ‚Budi!‘ – i ona biva.“ – stvaranje bez prethodnog uzora i tvari, kako Njemu priliči; ar-Rāġib navodi početne riječi, ‚Stvoritelj nebesa i Zemlje‘.
explanation.en: “The Originator of the heavens and the earth! When He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.” — creation with no prior model or matter, as befits Him; ar-Rāġib cites the opening words, ‘Originator of the heavens and the earth’.

quranTranslation.text: The Originator of the heavens and the earth! How can He have a child, when there is for Him no consort, when He created all things and is Aware of all things?

explanation.bs: „Stvoritelj nebesa i Zemlje! Kako bi On imao dijete …“
explanation.en: “The Originator of the heavens and the earth! How can He have a child”
